methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a specific command sequence.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: git update-index
methods.description: Commands to update Git index with specified files or paths.

methods.name: git init
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository in the specified directory.

methods.name: git commit
methods.description: Records changes in the repository with a message.

methods.name: git ls-files
methods.description: Lists files in the index or working directory with options for killed (-k) and modified (-m) files.

methods.description: Checks for prerequisites, such as symlinks support.
